conventions.AC: event-accumulate: coded-stream projections counted as K_s(T)*ac_updates_s ADDs using the REAL measured nonzero scalar event counts from the frozen E1 reports; all other groups dense as executed
conventions.conservative_MAC: every graph-layer projection counted as a full dense MAC (no sparsity credit): T*L*(4N+E)*d^2 MACs; all other groups identical to AC

formulas.ac_projection_add: sum_s K_s(T)*ac_updates_s (K_s = measured cumulative nonzero scalar events over all ticks and all 5000 graphs)
formulas.activation_relu: T*L*(N+E)*d comparisons (priced as ADD-equivalent); final layer edge ReLU pruned
formulas.batch_norm: T*L*(N+E)*d MUL + T*L*(N+E)*d ADD (node + edge BN, gamma*x+beta); final layer edge BN pruned
formulas.decoder_one_over_t: 1 DIV per element per active source call, explicitly counted (NOT assumed free power-of-two shift)
formulas.dense_projection_mac: T*L*(4*N*d^2 + E*d^2): A,B,D,E on N nodes and C on E edges, all four layers at EVERY tick
formulas.final_unused_edge_pruned: subtract T*(E*d) for each of: final-layer edge BN MUL, BN ADD, ReLU, residual ADD. Applied IDENTICALLY to every row including ANN (fair pruning).
formulas.graded_banks: 8 threshold comparisons per element per active source call (num_thresholds=8)
formulas.head: (head_calls/P) * [B*3215 MAC + B*(35+17) ReLU] once per endpoint; dc_adapt_six_site evaluates the head every tick
formulas.normalization: T*L*N*d ADD (denominator+eps) + T*L*N*d DIV (priced as MUL-equivalent)
formulas.residual_add: T*L*(N+E)*d ADD (raw h/e skips) + T*L*N*d ADD (A(h)+message); final layer edge skip pruned
formulas.setup_embedding_mac: 350*N + 70*E once per (mode,T) sweep (5->70 node + 1->70 edge embeddings)
formulas.sigmoid: T*L*E*d scalar sigmoids (declared, priced as MUL-equivalent; real hardware cost unresolved)
formulas.source_per_active_call_per_element: 1 SUB + 1 MUL (t*(raw-prev)) + 1 DIV (event/t) + 1 ADD (decoded accumulate) + 2 state read/write traffic
formulas.storage: declared FP32 bank/state bytes = n_sites*d^2*8*4 (one d x d pre-scaled bank per coded site per source level) + 2*sum_s(elements_s)*4 (two persistent state tensors per site); DECLARED, not measured memory traffic
formulas.traffic: declared scalar state read/write counts and accumulator touches; DECLARED, not measured memory traffic

accounting_model.scope: complete KNOWN arithmetic-operation count of the AS-IMPLEMENTED dense PyTorch prototype for one full 5000-graph validation sweep; not hardware energy, not hardware latency, not a cache/backend claim
unresolved_items: hardware latency and hardware energy (not measured; no chip-energy claim)
real DRAM/cache memory traffic bytes (only DECLARED scalar counts)
event-bank construction, pre-scaling, 1/t time-specific bank variants, address/routing logic
cache-equality checks, invalidation and maintenance for reused layer-0 state
sigmoid/division/ReLU transcendental hardware cost (priced only by declared ADD/MUL equivalents)
weight/bank storage precision, accumulator width, overflow handling, quantization
BN fold-vs-execute implementation choice; bias/setup terms beyond declared embedding
the fused first-analog/centered cache and event-driven projection backend are NOT implemented: the dense prototype recomputes all four graph layers at every tick
host-side Python/DataLoader overhead and host<->device transfer time are excluded from the declared arithmetic ledger (measured separately as wall-clock)

groups.scope: single dense teacher forward; no source, no decoder, no 1/t, no graded banks

limitations: This is a declared arithmetic-operation count of the dense PyTorch prototype, NOT hardware energy or hardware latency.
Cost contains explicitly enumerated unresolved items; per PROTOCOL-v3 'Cost with unresolved omitted work cannot pass', it cannot by itself establish a method advantage.
No event-count-as-energy claim, no 5x energy claim, no efficient-title claim.
The fused first-analog/centered cache and event-driven projection backend are not implemented in this prototype.

representative_batch_check.manual_check: A/B/D/E weights (70x70) applied to n0 nodes and C (70x70) to e0 edges, summed over the four frozen layers; controller ADDs traced to z composition, two index_add_ reductions, denominator+eps and A(h)+message residual. Weights are the frozen seed-41 checkpoint.
